query: WITH locked_genres AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id, name FROM genres WHERE id = ANY($1) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE ), locked_moods AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id, name FROM moods WHERE id = ANY($1) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE ), locked_tags AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id, name FROM tags WHERE id = ANY($1) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE ) SELECT 'genres' AS "field!", id AS "id!", name AS "name!" FROM locked_genres UNION ALL SELECT 'moods', id, name FROM locked_moods UNION ALL SELECT 'tags', id, name FROM locked_tags
